CRM data cleaning services and lead support

A CRM virtual assistant keeps contact records clean, routes leads and tracks follow-ups in a pipeline your sales team can review.

With CRM data entry services, we verify new contact fields against your intake records and flag missing information before it stalls a follow-up. Your sales team gets a list of proposed merges alongside the records that still need an owner.

Lead generation, inside sales and CRM administration

Use a CRM virtual assistant to organise new enquiries, prospecting, qualification and the next sales action. Agree your sources, contact rules and what counts as a qualified lead first.

Prospect and qualify

Build verified prospect lists from approved sources. Apply agreed criteria to inbound or outbound leads, capture the reason for qualification and route uncertain cases to sales.

Follow up and book meetings

Handle agreed follow-up calls and emails using approved sequences, record replies and nurture status, book appointments, send reminders and organise context for the sales owner. Confirm sending permissions and escalation limits.

Set up and maintain your CRM

CRM data cleaning services can include field formats, tags, filters, segments and duplicate checks. Use CRM data entry services to prepare contact imports or exports and test an approved sample before a batch change.

Support proposals and account follow-up

Maintain stages, owners, due dates and activity reports. Prepare proposals and sales materials, track onboarding, renewals, partner referrals and open deals, and flag decisions for the sales owner.

LinkedIn prospecting and sales support

Bring the audience, account criteria and outreach rules. A lead generation virtual assistant can keep research, approvals and follow-up history together.

Account and contact research

A CRM virtual assistant can use permitted LinkedIn or Sales Navigator features to build an account shortlist and identify contacts. Record the source and rationale and check against your CRM.

Message and follow-up preparation

Draft contextual connection notes and follow-up messages for review. Record agreed outreach and responses, route interested prospects to sales and keep opt-outs visible.

Handoff and reporting

A CRM virtual assistant tracks qualified replies, meetings and next actions. Your team approves outreach, sender access and what happens when a prospect asks for pricing or a commitment.

Checks for CRM data cleaning services

CRM data entry services need checks for required fields and ownership. CRM data cleaning services also need explicit rules for duplicates and conflicting values.

  • Preserve the source and timestamp of new records.
  • Check owner, next action and due date before closing intake.
  • Preview bulk edits on a small batch.
  • Flag unclear consent or outreach permissions.

Recover an enquiry with no owner

A CRM virtual assistant can recover the enquiry history. CRM data entry services should leave the sales owner with the source message and next action.

A contact arrives from an event list and also submits a website enquiry. The CRM contains an older record for the same organisation. A good handoff recognises the overlap, preserves the contact’s original context and puts a concrete action in front of the right owner.

  1. 01

    Find and compare the records

    Search the CRM using the email and organisation. Check whether the older record is active and whether there is an open opportunity. Keep the source and date of the new enquiry even if the contact is a confirmed match.

  2. 02

    Apply the agreed routing rule

    Confirm the relevant product, region or existing account owner using the rules the sales team supplied. If the information is incomplete, assign the enquiry to the triage queue and note the missing field. Avoid advancing the stage by guessing.

  3. 03

    Make the next action explicit

    Set a task with a due date, give the owner the enquiry context and record any follow-up that has already been sent. A pipeline reviewer should be able to open the record and see the reason for the action without searching another tool.

Prepare the inputs and rules.

Provide mapping rules before starting CRM data entry services. Your CRM virtual assistant needs to know which system owns each field.

Field rules for CRM data entry services

List the required contact and opportunity fields. Specify acceptable values, the source of truth and whether a missing value should be left blank or sent to a reviewer.

CRM virtual assistant routing rules

Provide the approved rules for assigning new enquiries and flag channels with different permissions. Document who reviews an uncertain consent status before a message is sent.

Test records for CRM data cleaning services

Choose a new enquiry, an existing customer and a likely duplicate for the first batch. Agree the expected outcomes so the team can validate the rules against real edge cases.

Decide what happens when the normal rule fails.

CRM data cleaning services should keep uncertain records visible. Your CRM virtual assistant can prepare a decision request before any merge or deletion.

Similar records may be different people

Preserve both records and list the fields that disagree. The approved reviewer decides whether to merge, update or leave them separate.

A lead has two possible owners

Use the documented tie-break rule if it applies. Otherwise record both candidates and assign the decision to the pipeline owner.

A bulk cleanup would change reporting

Pause before changing the affected fields. Show a sample of the proposed changes and ask the report owner to confirm the impact.

Check the work against the original brief.

Review CRM data entry services by checking a few changed records. CRM data cleaning services should show which values were verified and which still need confirmation.

Unassigned enquiries

Review the queue for items without an owner. Separate gaps in the intake form from gaps in the assignment rules.

Follow-up completeness

Sample active records and check the owner, next action and date. A populated stage does not help if nobody knows who should act.

Review CRM data cleaning services

Compare a small set of updates with the original source. Track fields that repeatedly need correction so the team can improve the intake process.

Leave a record the next person can use.

Your CRM virtual assistant should preserve the current task owner and deadline. CRM data entry services need a record of unfinished imports and outstanding approvals.

Part of the handoverWhat to recordWhat the next owner can do
Current workWhat to recordInclude the latest version, the source link and the current status. Note what was already checked and which changes were approved.What the next owner can doContinue from the latest approved state without searching for the source or repeating a completed check.
Open decisionsWhat to recordList each outstanding decision, the person who can make it and the point at which the next owner should follow up.What the next owner can doPrioritise the blocked items and ask a specific question when the next approval is due.
Time-sensitive commitmentsWhat to recordState the time zone, the next update due and any commitments that someone has already shared. Include the agreed backup contact.What the next owner can doKeep the next promise visible and make sure requests that cannot wait reach the correct person.
Changes to the instructionsWhat to recordRecord which rule changed, who approved it and when it starts. Keep an example that shows the difference in practice.What the next owner can doUse the current rule and compare new work with the agreed example during the next review.

Plan CRM data entry services around incoming leads

Plan CRM data cleaning services around campaign and event batches. Your CRM virtual assistant should distinguish those records from time-sensitive inbound enquiries.

High-intent enquiries

Decide how often to review demo forms and what information is required to route a request. Keep the source message linked and flag incomplete requests for review before assigning them to the wrong account.

Event and campaign lists

Set aside a separate review pass to check source, duplicate records and any fields your team requires before outreach. A small reviewed batch makes it easier to find mapping errors before they affect a full import.

CRM virtual assistant follow-up ownership

Name a backup for unassigned enquiries and set the point at which an overdue task goes back to the sales lead. The backup needs the last touch, the promised next step and any reason the original owner paused.

Frequently Asked Questions

Ask which fields a CRM virtual assistant can change. Agree how CRM data cleaning services handle missing information, duplicate contacts and bulk updates.

Can you clean up an existing CRM?

Agree the fields and cleanup rules, then review a small batch before making larger changes.

Does this include sales outreach?

Follow-up administration and sending authority should be scoped separately. Agree who owns messaging, consent and sales decisions.

How do you handle duplicate contacts?

Agree which fields identify a match. Flag uncertain records for review and confirm who approves merges before any records are combined.

What should a pipeline report include?

Start with new leads, overdue follow-ups, unassigned records and items blocked by a decision. Use definitions your team can verify against the CRM.

Can you route leads from several sources?

List each source, the information it provides and the owner rules. Test how the process handles missing fields, duplicates and unassigned leads.

Can we keep our existing pipeline stages?

Yes. Start from your current stage definitions and document ambiguous transitions before changing records or reports.
